newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity swaps managers on six Select funds.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity swaps managers on six Select funds.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said it swapped managers on six of its Select funds, which invest in specific industry sectors, to give them wider exposure and more experience.
"It's just part of the rotation of assignments. We periodically rotate the assignments of our managers to expose them to different industries and market sectors," spokeswoman Robyn Tice told Reuters.
Nick Romano was named portfolio manager of Fidelity Select Developing Communications Portfolio, succeeding Minerva Butler who managed the fund since 1996.
Minerva Butler was named manager of Fidelity Select Industrial Equipment Portfolio, succeeding Paul Antico who managed the fund since 1996.

Antico, sector leader of Fidelity's consumer equity research group will continue to manage Fidelity Select Leisure, Fidelity Select Consumer Industries, and Fidelity Advisor Consumer Industries portfolios.
George Domolky was named manager of Fidelity Select American Gold Portfolio and Fidelity Select Precious Metals & Minerals Portfolio.

Domolky succeeds Larry Rakers, who will continue to manage Fidelity Select Paper & Forest Products Portfolio, Fidelity Select Energy Portfolio and Fidelity Advisor Natural Resources Portfolio. Rakers is sector leader of Fidelity's natural resources research group.
Tom Allen was named portfolio manager of Fidelity Select Insurance Portfolio. He succeeds Mike Tempero, who will continue to manage Fidelity Select Computers Portfolio.

Peter Fruzzetti was named portfolio manager of Fidelity Select Brokerage & Investment Management Portfolio. He succeeds Louis Salemy, who will continue to manage Fidelity Select Financial Services Portfolio and Fidelity Advisor Financial Services Portfolio. In addition, Salemy is sector leader of Fidelity's financial services research group.
